data.narrative: The student turned a hang-with-green-/live outage into fail-closed 503s by adding engine connect/pool/statement timeouts and mapping OperationalError to a named failure_mode log. BREAK used existing evidence instead of another infinite connect: /ready TIMEOUT with no 5xx, plus GET /r/{code} coupling a user read to an analytics write. FIX re-sim showed /ready 503 in 4.271s and POST /links 503 without a traceback in the client body.

dimension_scores.observation: Timeouts were added on the SQLAlchemy engine the container process uses; no Docker DNS /etc/hosts injection was run.
dimension_scores.evidence: api/app/db.py connect_timeout=2 and statement_timeout=2000ms; Docker daemon was previously unavailable so Option A DNS was diagnosed from code and localhost URL, not docker exec.

dimension_scores.observation: Failure handling is in the request path, not a new CI stage.
dimension_scores.evidence: No GitHub Actions job was added; verification is api/app/scripts/module05_failure_fix_verify.py against ASGI.

dimension_scores.observation: Hang is now a 503 that HighErrorRate can see, with logs that name the mode instead of a generic 500.
dimension_scores.evidence: FIX re-sim log: database unavailable action=ready failure_mode=postgres_connect_or_query_timeout error_type=ConnectionTimeout; /live still 200 in 0.159s.

dimension_scores.observation: Ranked unbounded connect wait as highest risk because it is invisible to 5xx alerts, and added the missed partial-failure row for redirect writes.
dimension_scores.evidence: BREAK artifact: S1_READY_HANG_NO_500_NO_METRIC_COMPLETION vs GET /r/{code} SELECT then INSERT analytics; FMEA gained postgres partial-failure row.

dimension_scores.observation: Implemented per-path stance: 503 on lookup/create, keep /live up, fail-open only on analytics after a successful lookup.
dimension_scores.evidence: GET /ready and POST /links return 503 in 4.2–4.9s; redirect lookup 503; analytics insert is a separate transaction with warn postgres_write_partial_failure.

dimension_scores.observation: FMEA inventory, 12+ modes, simulations with actual timings, and FIX table comparing hang vs 503.
dimension_scores.evidence: progress/production-module5-fmea.md, break.md, fix.md include command outputs FIX_READY_ELAPSED_S 4.271 and Sim2 ConnectionTimeout 4.451s.

strengths: Did not repeat the infinite engine.connect hang; reused TIMEOUT and Sim2 timings as BREAK evidence.
Made fail-closed detectable: ConnectionTimeout -> named log -> 503 instead of fail-opaque hang.
Caught GET /r/{code} as a write-on-read partial-failure mode and decoupled analytics from redirect.
growth_areas: Analytics fail-open path was not exercised against a live read-only Postgres (lookup still times out in this environment).
No circuit breaker/backoff yet; that is Module 06, and tight client retries on 503 remain a residual risk.
data.recommendation: In Module 06, add a circuit breaker around engine.connect so repeated ConnectionTimeout on /links does not keep paying the 4s connect_timeout on every request.

public_evidence.student_action: Added connect/pool/statement timeouts and mapped database unavailability to HTTP 503 with a named failure-mode log, keeping /live independent.
public_evidence.technical_detail: api/app/db.py connect_timeout=2; api/app/main.py raise_db_unavailable on /ready, POST /links, redirect lookup; analytics INSERT decoupled from redirect.
public_evidence.proof: module05_failure_fix_verify.py: GET /live 200 in 0.159s; GET /ready 503 in 4.271s; POST /links 503; GET /r/abc123 503; client body service temporarily unavailable; log failure_mode=postgres_connect_or_query_timeout.
public_evidence.ability: Turns dependency hang into a bounded, observable fail-closed response without inventing fallback data.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Shows production judgment: timeouts, 503 vs 500, liveness vs readiness, and not coupling redirects to telemetry writes.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: URL lookup/create 503; analytics write warn+redirect; /live 200 without Postgres.
Before FIX /ready TIMEOUT with no 5xx; after FIX ConnectionTimeout in 4.271s as 503.
GET /r/{code} SELECT then INSERT analytics; /ready is SELECT 1 only.

teaching_approaches.detail: Compared hang (no 5xx) vs other modes using recorded ASGI and Sim2 timings.
